title: Basic Kitchen Towels
text: Basic Kitchen Towels. These towels are basic, no frills kitchen towels. They remind me of the type you might buy at the grocery store. They are better than the ones you would get at the dollar store. The color is a nice, blue. They wash well and have a decent absorption quality. These are great for quick clean ups.
